description: Pause a supervised session and ask a person to help. Explain what they need to do in reason. Returns waiting_for_human, the reason, human_wait_expires_at and a one-time viewer_url to give the person. Agent actions are refused until they return control. Repeating this request renews the viewer grant without extending the wait deadline.

reason.description: What the person needs to do in the browser.

session_id.description: Supervised session ID. Defaults to this connection's active session.

name: request_human
title: Request human help
